notes.title: Mushroom Murder Nerf
notes.content:
Due to reports of mushroom elevators misbehaving and murdering players, I have replaced them with a new less-lethal elevator system. I also made some quality of life improvements to scaling mushrooms and the entrance to the wizard tower, so if those parts of the game turned you away then now is the time to give the game another try!

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Launch Notes, Bug Fixes, Donation DLC
notes.content:
First off - I wanted to give a huge thank you to everybody for the great launch! I'm glad you could look past the rough parts of the game to appreciate the hard work I put into it. Every download, comment and review means a lot to me.

Second - I fixed the two bugs that people have pointed out so far: collision issues on mushrooms, and the bad respawn point at the start of the Wizard Tower area. Please let me know if anybody finds any other issues!

Third - I added a dumb $5 DLC thing as a way for people to donate money for the game, since that was the most common request on the Reddit thread. You can find a link on the game's store page. The DLC doesn't change the actual game at all, it's just a video about how I made it and some art. You should just save your money for more important things!

Thanks again!
